entities.summary: Agnellus of Pisa, OFM, was an Italian Franciscan friar. As the order's first minister provincial in England (1224–1236), he is considered the founder of the Franciscans in England. His feast day is variously observed in the Catholic Church, on 7 May or 10 September.
